 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Como bring Nico Paz back into the starting XI with Tasos Douvikas and Lucas Da Cunha for the trip to on form Torino, who have Che Adams and Giovanni Simeone upfront.
 It kicks off at the Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino at 19.45 GMT (20.45 CET).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement You can follow all the build-up and action as it happens from this game, Sassuolo-Lazio and Roma-Cagliari on the Liveblog. 
 Fabregas: ‘Some Como players understand the need for rotation less than others’ ITALY – OCTOBER 24: Head coach Como Cesc Fabregas looks on during the Serie A match between Como 1907 and US Sassuolo at Giuseppe Sinigaglia Stadium on October 24, 2026 in Italy. (Photo by Claudio Villa/Getty Images)
 It has been a remarkable season for Como, who blew Manchester United away 4-1 in the Champions League and settled into fifth place in Serie A.
 The extra commitment of European football has taken its toll on fitness levels, so Moise Kean, Mattia Liberali, Jesus Rodriguez, Assane Diao and Trevoh Chalobah have not made the trip.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement That means Douvikas must remain upfront, ready to celebrate signing a new contract until June 2031.
 Nico Paz was rested for the 2-0 victory over Sassuolo and returns here with Da Cunha and Maxence Caqueret.
 ITALY – OCTOBER 24: Tasos Douvikas of Como celebrates after scoring the opening goal during the Serie A match between Como 1907 and US Sassuolo at Giuseppe Sinigaglia Stadium on October 24, 2026 in Italy. (Photo by Claudio Villa/Getty Images)
 Torino are on spectacular form and have won their last three matches in a row against Udinese, Parma and Monza.
 Rolando Mandragora suffered a thigh injury and is out of action along with Niccolò Fortini, Ricardo Rodriguez and Franco Israel.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Summer signing Daniel Braganca therefore steps into midfield with Kian Fitz-Jim and Nikola Vlasic.
 Adams is the strike partner for Simeone, with Alessio Cacciamani out wide on the left.
 FLORENCE, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 5: Che Adams of Torino FC in action with Radu Dragusin and Christ Inao Oulai of Fiorentina during the Serie A match between ACF Fiorentina and Torino FC at Stadio Artemio Franchi on September 5, 2026 in Florence, Italy. (Photo by Gabriele Maltinti/Getty Images)
 Torino vs. Como line-ups
 Torino : Perri; Coco, Ismajli, Comuzzo; Belghali, Vlasic, Braganca, Fitz-Jim, Cacciamani; Adams, Simeone
 Como : Sanchez; Couto, Ramon, Kempf, Valle; Perrone, Milla; Da Cunha, Nico Paz, Caqueret; Douvikas
